# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Texture that transforms every bite

See how our collaborative approach turns concepts into next-level sensory experiences

[Explore texture innovations][1]

Mobile Image

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative
agriculture practices deliver unmatched, [industry-leading sustainability results][3] that help
propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

### Measurably advance your ESG outcomes

**How Ingredion can help:**
* Collaborate to identify and prioritize your sustainability initiatives because what matters to
  you, matters to us
* Help execute on your ESG goals, measure progress and report meaningful advancements to your
  stakeholders
* Sustainably deliver products with the taste, texture and benefits consumers prefer

[Learn more][4]

[Picture 735315543]

## Our expertise

Ingredion is much more than a supplier. A partnership with us will enable you to increase speed to

## We Are Experts In Developing Plant-Based, Clean Label Ingredient Solutions

Backed by 30 years of experience serving the food and beverage industry, we develop clean,
functional ingredients sourced from nature to deliver clean label solutions for health and
nutrition, food safety, and natural shelf life extension. We pioneer new ingredient technologies and
partner with customers to address the needs of today's food industry.

Our clients trust us to be their ingredient partner and support them with product innovation and
development, food safety and sustainability, product formulations, and ingredient sourcing.
Ingredient innovation is supported by our analytical and wet chemistry lab, microbiology, R&D, and
food applications team. Their role is to support and create value for our customers and develop a
deeper understanding of the ingredient solutions we offer.

### Clean Label

Our functional ingredients are clean, simple, and natural and meet the clean label claim, so you can
be honest about what is in your products.

[Scientist Inspecting Mycotoxin Risks]

### Free-From

Our ingredients are free from GMOs, and most are free from common allergens, like gluten, soy, and
dairy. Helping you develop simple, healthier food products is our goal.

[Scientist Examining Samples with a Microscope]

### Superior Quality

We partner with suppliers who share our dedication to sustaining high-quality social, ethical,
environmental, and product standards.

[Quality Control Workers Reviewing Data]

### Application Versatility

Our ingredient solutions are some of the most versatile on the market. Each ingredient works well in
plenty of applications and, depending on the product, meets or exceeds the taste and functional
benefits of its rivals.

[Plant-based ingredients sourced from nature]

## Our Ingredients Are Sourced From Nature

A&B Ingredients is a clean label manufacturer and supplier of unique ingredients coming directly
from nature. We are a trusted source of plant-based, functional ingredient solutions, including
vegetable proteins, fibers, starches, texturized plant proteins, and specialty flours. In addition,
our ingredient portfolio includes natural shelf life extenders, mold inhibitors, antimicrobials,
antioxidants, as well as flavor enhancers, probiotics, and low sodium sea salt.

We offer clean, innovative solutions for the food and beverage industry. Applications include meat
and poultry, dairy products, vegetarian alternatives, baked goods and snacks, beverages, sauces and
dressings, soups, infant, clinical nutrition and dietetic, and pet food.

[Resources][11][Search Ingredients][12]

## Personalized Approach To Product Formulation And Innovation

Our sales and application teams are dedicated to helping you succeed, create value, and assist in
your new product development. We offer ingredient expertise, technical support, and formulation
assistance to our valued customers.

With extensive formulation expertise and a fully equipped in-house application lab, we can guarantee
a personalized approach when we support you with new product development initiatives.

**Helping our customers differentiate and add value to their products.**

Addmaster supplies antimicrobial additives for plastics, coatings, textiles, paper, packaging and

protection that lasts for the lifetime of the product.

technical, regulatory and marketing support designed to help bring products to market faster and
maximise their commercial potential.

From product development and regulatory compliance to co-branding and marketing initiatives, our
team works alongside customers at every stage of the journey. Unlike many suppliers, this support is

## **ANTIMICROBIAL** PRODUCT PROTECTION TECHNOLOGY

Addmaster are your trusted partner in adding value to your products by providing superior additive
technologies. Our cutting-edge antimicrobial additives and antimicrobial solutions are engineered to
reduce viral load and prevent microbial degradation.

With a relentless focus on innovation and more than 25 years of experience, Addmaster leads the
industry in developing solutions that promote cleaner, more hygienic environments.

At Addmaster, our advanced technologies are designed to not only combat microbes but also prevent
future resistance development, providing long-term product protection for your surfaces and
products.

Join the fight against microbes with Addmaster's comprehensive range of antimicrobial additives.
Experience peace of mind knowing that your surfaces are fortified, whilst your products set new
standards of excellence.

###### Our Technologies

## How can we** add value** to your world today?
* [Biomaster]
  
  Biomaster, a silver ion technology, is an antimicrobial technology easily incorporated into any
  plastic, textile, paper, paint or coating.
  
  Biomaster guarantees fast, effective antimicrobial product protection for the effective lifetime
  of the product, helps to keep surfaces clean and reduces potential for cross-contamination.
* [Verimaster]
  
  Verimaster anti counterfeit technology offers a fail-safe solution to your brand protection and
  product verification requirements.
  
  Invisible to the naked eye and lasting the lifetime of your product, Verimaster antimicrobial
  technology is detectable only by our bespoke sensory or optical detectors.
* [Scentmaster]
  
  Scentmaster Masterbatches present a wide range of fragrances for introduction into a variety of
  product materials.
  
  Due to its high fragrance concentration, Scentmaster introduction rates are typically 1% or lower
  - making it a cost-effective, as well as appealing addition to your product.
* [Masterpiece]
  
  Masterpiece Technology is available to any customer whose product specification demands the
  creation of a bespoke additive solution.
  
  Masterpiece will research, develop and implement your additive – even offering ongoing technical
  support throughout product manufacture.

  Biomaster, a silver ion technology, is an antimicrobial technology easily incorporated into any
  plastic, textile, paper, paint or coating.
  
  Biomaster guarantees fast, effective antimicrobial product protection for the effective lifetime
  of the product, helps to keep surfaces clean and reduces potential for cross-contamination.
* [Verimaster]
  
  Verimaster anti counterfeit technology offers a fail-safe solution to your brand protection and
  product verification requirements.
  
  Invisible to the naked eye and lasting the lifetime of your product, Verimaster antimicrobial
  technology is detectable only by our bespoke sensory or optical detectors.
* [Scentmaster]
  
  Scentmaster Masterbatches present a wide range of fragrances for introduction into a variety of
  product materials.
  
  Due to its high fragrance concentration, Scentmaster introduction rates are typically 1% or lower
  - making it a cost-effective, as well as appealing addition to your product.
* [Masterpiece]
  
  Masterpiece Technology is available to any customer whose product specification demands the
  creation of a bespoke additive solution.
  
  Masterpiece will research, develop and implement your additive – even offering ongoing technical
  support throughout product manufacture.

## Elevating Aircraft Performance, One Part At A Time

Since 1983, DK Turbines has been one of the most trusted suppliers of airframe, turbine and avionics
parts for the corporate aviation fleet. DK Turbines stocks a wide variety of airframe parts for
[Learjet][39], Falcon, King Air, Citation, Hawker and Challenger aircraft and engine parts for
TFE731, TPE331, [CJ610][40], CF700, and PT6 engines. All parts are available for immediate worldwide
shipment to get and keep your aircraft flying.

Our goal is to provide the parts you need to get and keep your aircraft flying. Our inventory
includes an extensive stock of airframe and engine rotables, including [avionics][41],
[instruments][42], [starter generators][43], [oxygen masks][44], [valves][45], hydraulic pumps,
[fuel pumps][46], [actuators][47], motors, [wheels][48], and [brakes][49].

DK Turbines makes available through our subsidiary, [Kalitta Turbines][54], a large inventory of
TFE731 and [CJ610][55] engines. These engines are ready and available for immediate short-term and
long-term leases along with outright and exchange engine sales.

### Engine Maintenance

DK Turbines also refers to [Kalitta Turbines][57] for maintenance, service and repair of General
Electric CJ610 and CF700 engines. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing the highest quality
of service to our customers.

[][58]

## Kalitta Strong With Doug kalitta holdings

DK Turbines is equipped to provide exceptional aircraft parts and service solutions, anywhere and
anytime, thanks to its connection to the powerful network of companies under Doug Kalitta Holdings.
As part of this extensive group, DK Turbines leverages the combined resources and expertise of its
sister companies to ensure unmatched service and flexibility for customers. With a commitment to
excellence and the strength of “Kalitta Strong,” DK Turbines is ready to tackle any challenge in
aviation parts and deliver outstanding results.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

### Natural food preservatives manufacturers

ITA began with its founding in the 80s and grew up with its second generation of the family.
We are chemists, food technologists, clerks and factory workers that love working here.
We have been working for thirty years in order supporting the shelf life of the great Italian food
industry products and we have lived in first person the change of the food sector which made us
understand that the less it is chemical, the more is real!
We do not resell third-party ingredients or simple commodities, but produce us **natural
preservatives for food industry**, as it is more important selecting and researching instead of
manipulating the raw material.
We enjoy working. That's why, if we tell you that we carefully follow our production and your
products, you should believe us.

Our mission is become a point of reference among the [natural food preservatives manufacturers][24]
all over the word.

HIGHLIGHTS
[[Natural shelf life extenders for bakery, pastry and desserts? They are surely Made in ITA! ]][26]

## NATURAL SHELF LIFE EXTENDERS FOR BAKERY, PASTRY AND DESSERTS? THEY ARE SURELY MADE IN ITA!

A few years ago we decided to produce only natural shelf life extenders - natural ingredients that
are used in recipes to achieve a specific goal, such as prolonging the life of baked goods, pastries
or desserts - or preserving their appearance longer. We took the opportunity to eliminate the
chemical components of traditional food preservatives and life extensions and we focused on the
products that you can find on our website and you can only buy from us. What a golden opportunity!

[Read more][27]
 
[[Surface mould, bye bye.]][28]

## SURFACE MOULD, BYE BYE.

It’s a natural aromatic preparation, which vaporizes before packaging, it is also used in organic
products and does not alter the smell and taste when the packet is opened: instead it cancels the
effect of the alcoholic "flush". The new Complesso Limone® SPK is the killer of surface moulds and
is a signature product of ITA FOOD IMPROVERS®.

## About Niran Bio Tech

Niran Bio Tech is a global supplier of food ingredients and additives, providing functional
ingredient solutions for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global supplier network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of acidulants and functional ingredients, supporting
consistent quality, flavor balance, and performance across diverse food and beverage applications,
including beverage, bakery, confectionery, dairy, and nutrition products.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

## About Us

Vinayak Ingredients (INDIA) Pvt. Ltd. was established in 2000 as one of the first Menthol producers
in India. Soon Vinayak Ingredients (INDIA) Pvt. Ltd. ventured into the arena of food coloring and
flavoring agents.

VIPL focuses and believes in use of Ingredients of natural origin and envisions replacing all
chemical origin raw materials with eco-sustainable natural solutions. Following the same path, VIPL
developed Ecoflav, Ecocol and Esiol which are the solutions for Natural flavors, Natural colors and
standardized Essential oils respectively. Vinayak Ingredients (INDIA) Pvt. Ltd. intends on
minimizing its foot print on the environment and inculcates the same values in its operations.

# Welcome to Vinayak Ingredients – India’s Leading Manufacturer, Supplier, and Exporter of Premium
# Natural Colours and Pigments

**At Vinayak Ingredients**, we proudly stand as one of the **top manufacturers, suppliers, and
exporters** of **high-quality natural colours, pigments, and powders** in India. With **decades of
experience** and a **commitment to excellence**, we serve a **diverse global clientele** across
**Asia, Europe, the Americas, Africa, and Oceania**—delivering **non-toxic** and **skin-safe colour
solutions** tailored for your **industry needs**.

## Our Extensive Product Categories

We offer a **comprehensive range of products** under the following categories, with a wide variety
of items available within each:
* [**Natural Food Colours**][39]
* [**Modified Starch**][40]
* [**Fruit Powders**][41]
* [**Vegetable Powders**][42]
* [**Fat Powder**][43]
* [**Miscellaneous Products**][44]

Each product is carefully formulated and supplied to meet the exacting standards of food, cosmetics,
pharmaceutical, and other industries.

## Why Choose Vinayak Ingredients?
* **Trusted Manufacturer, Supplier & Exporter:** We ensure **consistent quality and reliable
  supply** throughout manufacturing and exporting, making us your dependable partner for natural
  colour solutions worldwide.
* **Global Supply Network:** We proudly serve customers in:

    Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jammu & Kashmir, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal,
    North East States, Gujarat, Kerala, Goa, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Mumbai Metro
